summary: Appellant convicted under sections 302;324;326/34 IPC; murder vs culpable homicide; premeditation disputed; eyewitness testimony (PW1) pivotal; private defense claim rejected; medical evidence corroborated fatal knife injuries; knife recovered via Section 27 Evidence Act; High Court affirmed conviction; plea for sentence reduction based on age and illness rejected; conviction under Section 302 upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and life sentence under Section 302 IPC upheld; concurrent sentences for Sections 326 and 324 IPC maintained.
